messages:
dalia: hi! first day and ran into a snag. my company laptop shipping got delayed. I need to sign the NDA and finish security training, plus run a quick creds-only smoke test against a sandbox customer dataset. Is there a permitted path for a short-term exception?

kevin: welcome, dalia. short version: we avoid BYOD for anything that touches customer data. For a short smoke test we can provision a locked-down cloud sandbox VM or an ephemeral dev container with no persistent storage. That meets compliance if we enable endpoint telemetry and ephemeral vault creds.

ops: we can spin up a sandbox VM with the following controls: no persistent disk mounts, blocked clipboard, no downloads, logging to security telemetry, and SAML-only access. ETA ~3h after manager ok. Please specify if you need docker or a GUI.

dalia: no GUI, just python + pip and about 2GB data to pull for the smoke test. Also, can I complete the phishing simulation and training on my personal laptop while using the sandbox VM for data access? Im worried about failing phishsim during onboarding.

security: phishsim is mandatory for all employees and contractors. We can move your cohort window by up to 1 week for onboarding exceptions, but we do not exempt anyone. Training can be completed on personal devices; however, any access to sandboxed customer data must be from the provisioned VM. If you fail phishsim during the onboarding period, we send a learning notification and require retake earlier than standard cadence.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-50333 "Sandbox VM for onboarding - dalia". Status: awaiting manager approval. Assignee: ops. Controls requested: no-downloads, blocked-clipboard, ephemeral-creds.

kevin: dalia - ask your manager to reply in the ticket with approval using this template:
Manager: @marta (approved)
Request: sandbox VM (no persistent mounts, blocked clipboard, no downloads), python toolchain
Window: 72 hours or until company device arrives
Phishsim: move cohort by 1 week

dalia: done, manager replied and I added it to the ticket. Thanks!

ops: approval received. provisioning sandbox VM now and will DM connection details and a short runbook. Please finish training ASAP and enroll 2FA (Okta Verify OK temporarily).

security: reminder: please do not copy sensitive snippets into Slack or local files. Use the ephemeral vault for keys and rotate creds after session.

dalia: thanks team, appreciate the quick help. Ill complete training this afternoon and wait for VM details.
